Remember those big dreams you had as a kid? Maybe you wanted to climb mountains, or do something extraordinary, until life threw you a curveball you never expected. What happens when those dreams run headfirst into real, unexpected challenges? That's what we're about to explore, together.
In the pages of Just Don't Fall: How I Grew Up, Conquered Illness, and Made It Down the Mountain, Josh Sundquist invites us right into his world—a world that shifts from carefree childhood to the tough reality of a life-changing diagnosis. We'll walk with him through the tough days in hospital rooms, and then out onto the snowy mountains where every step forward is a triumph. There's loss and adaptation, yes, but also humor, vulnerability, and a fierce determination to chase new ambitions, no matter the odds. As we journey with Josh from uncertainty to self-discovery, from setbacks to those breathtaking moments of hope, we'll see what it really means to turn adversity into possibility. And along the way, we'll ask ourselves—what does success look like when life doesn't go as planned? This story isn't just about skiing or overcoming illness; it's about relationships, resilience, and finding strength where you least expect it. So, welcome to this journey. Together, let's discover how courage grows, how hope shines through, and how we can all find the power to keep moving forward—even when the path gets steep.
